title: Chocolate Hazelnut Spread Brownies
changes_from_base: A short batter built on chocolate hazelnut spread with toasted hazelnuts; no butter or chocolate.
summary: Dense, fudgy brownies made from chocolate hazelnut spread, eggs and a little flour, with toasted hazelnuts.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
blanched hazelnuts, toasted and finely chopped

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line and lightly grease the tin.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the spread, fine salt, espresso powder and eggs together with a spatula until completely smooth.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Fold in the flour and chopped hazelnuts until just combined; the batter will be thick.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread it into the corners, sprinkle with flaky salt and bake 18-22 min, until the centre is set and the edges pull away from the tin. A cocktail stick should show a few moist crumbs but no wet batter.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the tin before cutting into 16.

tips: Stir the spread well before measuring.
Do not overbake; they firm up as they cool.
Rub warm toasted hazelnuts in a tea towel to remove skins.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in an airtight box at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
